title: Refund window
text: Refunds are available within 30 days of the transaction date. After 30 days a credit note is offered instead.

title: Refund method
text: Refunds are returned to the original payment method only. Refunds to a different card or account are never permitted.

title: Approval threshold
text: Refunds above 500 GBP require approval by a supervisor before they are issued. Below 500 GBP an agent may approve.

title: Disputed charges
text: A disputed charge is investigated within 5 working days. The customer is informed of the outcome in writing.

title: Customer data
text: Agents may view only the fields needed for the ticket. Card numbers and national insurance numbers are never shown or logged.
